consultation.title: Consultation
consultation.purpose: Record the reason for the visit, history, assessment, and plan.

awakeOralExam.label: Awake oral examination
awakeOralExam.helper: Record visible oral findings and areas that could not be assessed while awake.
awakeOralExam.sample: Mild visible gingival redness. The caudal mouth could not be assessed.

preanesthetic.label: Pre-anesthetic considerations
preanesthetic.helper: Record relevant risks, previous anesthesia concerns and the testing or consultation discussed.
preanesthetic.sample: Prior anesthetic history reviewed. Pre-anesthetic testing discussed.

clientDiscussion.label: Client discussion and decisions
clientDiscussion.helper: Record options, estimate, consent status and any deferred or declined care. Keep decisions pending further assessment clear.
clientDiscussion.sample: A preliminary estimate was discussed. The client will decide after reviewing it.

homeCare.label: Home dental care
homeCare.helper: Record the home care guidance discussed and any practical limitations.
homeCare.sample: The client asked about options for home dental care.

followUp.label: Follow-up and scheduling
followUp.helper: Record the agreed next step, timing and any reason to contact the practice sooner.
followUp.sample: The client will contact the practice to schedule.

discharge.title: Discharge
discharge.purpose: Record the medications, care instructions, and follow-up discussed for this visit.

sourceNotice: Recorded wording stays as entered. Review the client language before sharing.

consultationCurrentMedications.label: Current medications
consultationCurrentMedications.helper: List medications already being taken. Note who reported them and any uncertainty.

consultationAdministeredMedications.label: Medications given during this visit
consultationAdministeredMedications.helper: Record what was actually given, with dose, route, and timing when known.

consultationMedicationPlan.label: Medication changes and prescriptions
consultationMedicationPlan.helper: Record prescriptions and decisions to start, continue, hold, stop, or change medication. Keep tentative plans conditional.

complaint.label: Reason for visit
complaint.helper: Shared with the patient details for this visit.

consultationHistory.label: History
consultationHistory.helper: Record the history provided and relevant context.

consultationAssessment.label: Assessment
consultationAssessment.helper: Record your assessment, including any uncertainty.

consultationPlan.label: Plan
consultationPlan.helper: Record the plan discussed; do not imply that planned care is complete.

dischargeMedications.label: Medications
dischargeMedications.helper: Use one line per medication. Include the name, dose, how and when to give it, and for how long.

dischargeInstructions.label: Instructions
dischargeInstructions.helper: Describe care at home, any activity or feeding restrictions, and when to call the clinic.

dischargeFollowUp.label: Follow-up
dischargeFollowUp.helper: List any next steps and when they should happen. For a scheduled recheck, use Recheck due in Patient.

gpVitals.label: Vital signs
gpVitals.helper: Record measured values with their units and any uncertainty.

gpPhysicalExam.label: Physical examination
gpPhysicalExam.helper: Record only examination findings observed or reported.

gpDiagnostics.label: Diagnostics
gpDiagnostics.helper: Record diagnostic findings and pending tests, keeping uncertainty.

gp-exam.title: GP examination
gp-exam.purpose: Record the vital signs, physical examination, and diagnostic findings for this visit.
